title: Data Change Impact Card
user: Data engineers maintaining mutable schemas and derived assets who need a compact explanation of what changed upstream, what is now stale, and what can safely be recomputed.
smallest_useful_product: A CLI that reads a small lineage manifest plus version/change events and emits Markdown/JSON cards showing impacted nodes, stale reason, declared recomputation order, and unknown edges.
success_measure: On a fixture DAG with 30 nodes and five changes, the CLI identifies all expected downstream stale nodes and no unrelated nodes.
constraints: Do not connect to production by default
Lineage claims must state their input completeness
Support redacted node names in exported cards
